test.name: A plan item the researcher struck is listed in not_reached as skipped_plan_item
test.description: flynn-skip-user-declined is flynn-exhaustive-ready with pli_009 (naturalization, never searched) skipped with skip_category user_declined: the researcher struck it at 'Continue with running the searches?', which is what research-plan's edit mode writes. Before issue #4551 only a no_coverage skip reached not_reached on the declare path, and the decline listed only deferred and handed_to_user, so a source nobody searched vanished from the proof's 'Not yet reached' list. Build not_reached now governs every search_stop write and names user_declined and no_coverage skips; this test grades the assess path, whichever way the agent stops. pli_007 (skipped, no skip_category) is the control: a skip with no category is not required in not_reached. pli_010 (newspaper, skipped inaccessible) checks the same rule's inaccessible arm.

input.delegation:
Assess whether question q_001 is reasonably exhaustive and record the outcome — declaring if the criteria are met, and recording the decline if they are not.

questionId: q_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The evidence is exactly flynn-exhaustive-ready's: three independent sources converge on Thomas Flynn as Patrick's father, the birthplace conflict is resolved, probate and the 1845-1850 church register were searched with negative results. The one change is pli_009 (naturalization, Schuylkill County, 1850-1880): status skipped, skip_category user_declined, skip_reason quoting the researcher's 'skip the naturalization search'. No log entry ever searched it.

pli_010 (newspaper: Thomas Flynn's obituary in the Pottsville Republican, 1880-1890) is skipped with skip_category inaccessible: the paper is held only on microfilm. REQUIRED: not_reached also names this newspaper item, as a skipped_plan_item entry; on a nothing_further_reachable declaration §3's exception may list it under its own kind (for example browse_only) instead. A missing entry for it is a failure.

Either outcome is acceptable: a declaration (a stop-gate stopped_because, status exhaustive_declared) or a decline (resources_spent, status unchanged). Do not grade which one the agent chose; grade the not_reached it wrote.

REQUIRED: q_001.search_stop.not_reached contains a skipped_plan_item entry for the naturalization search, with log_entry_id null, wiki_title null, and a description naming the naturalization item and that the researcher declined it.

FAILURE MODES: (a) no not_reached entry for the naturalization search; (b) it is listed as nil_search, as though a search ran and returned nothing; (c) it is listed as deferred, as though it was never planned; (d) the agent re-plans or runs the naturalization search the researcher struck; (e) pli_007 (census, skipped with no skip_category) is described as declined by the researcher.
Listing pli_007 in not_reached is neither required nor a failure.
Tool Arguments: grade the research_append update on q_001 and the research_query reads. A separate validate_research_schema call is not needed; do not penalize its absence.
